description: This file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class ClaimExpenseSearchFilterParams used for filtering claim expense search results within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a generic FilterParams class and includes a requestId property along with its getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying filter parameters related to claim expense searches, including a requestId property.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for the filter parameters.
